answer: Farms can clone signers, but not exclusive kiln time. A new key books one 75-minute berth at the public jetty crane, heats a 3.1 kg iron coupon on a coke forge to 820C, and presses a 6-digit nonce die into the face. Three cameras 35 meters apart log an 11-second optical beacon flash; the lux curve is hashed with the coupon stamp and signed on-ledger. A sibling key in the same slot cannot finish a second 820C ramp before the first coupon cools below 200C. If any camera misses two samples, the 29 POA bond is slashed and enrollment is refused; 9 POA returns after 6 quiet epochs.
